HAL delivers aircraft and helicopters to Indian forces

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) on Thursday delivered multiple aircraft and helicopters. The Indian Air Force received two Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Tejas Final Operational Clearance (FOC) Twin Seater Trainers and three HTT-40 Basic Trainers. Additionally, four Dhruv Next Generation (NG) helicopters were handed over to Pawan Hans Limited. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh attended the ceremony and praised HAL's achievements in promoting aerospace self-reliance.
